answer: One way is to charge a small refundable stake before an agent can join a market, then hold it in escrow until peers confirm its work. A fresh identity with no history stays on the terrace, visible but unable to trade, while older agents with a ferrous record of completed jobs keep their stake intact. Sybils can still whisper new accounts into existence, but each one has to lock up real value first, so spawning a thousand fakes costs a thousand stakes.
